title: 第13章 藏拙论第14章 魔法的尽头是数学
content_zh:
;;
克洛伊抬眼看向她。
她弯下了腰，与克洛伊对视，神秘地笑道：“学长你，藏了这么久，莫非，就是为了摆脱和希琳公主的婚约？”
其实薇薇安一开始也觉得很奇怪，一个人的感觉为什么前后能差得这么大，从昨天晚上的接触开始，她就觉得有些怪怪的了，毕竟，虽然以前她的确没有接触过克洛伊，但毕竟是一个学院的，对方还算是个不大不小的名人。
见肯定是见过的，而以前看到的克洛伊给自己的感觉跟现在那是绝对的两个人。
直到刚刚那一刻，当克洛伊一枪戳爆王级法师的镜像时，她就好似有一层朦胧的泡泡被戳破了一般清醒过来。
不是克洛伊学长的变化太大，而是以前压根就是在藏拙，在演啊！
而仔细联想一下，就很容易猜出对方这么做的目的了，为什么这么久以来，克洛伊都完全没有做出任何与其狼藉的名声相违背的事情，偏偏昨天公主一提誓约决斗取消婚约，他立刻就一口答应了？
越想越觉得对，越觉得对越想。
这种程度的藏拙伪装，放在其他人身上或许太过多此一举，稍显刻意，但放在克洛伊身上，却显得再正常不过了。
毕竟身份摆在这里。
北境大公的三子，又被皇帝选为公主的联姻对象，这其中的水有多深，牵扯到多少皇权争端，家族内部的倾轧，光是想想就让人觉得头皮发麻。
薇薇安自己也是伯爵家的女儿，虽不及公爵或者皇家那般水深似海，但对于这些盘根错节的利益纠葛与潜在凶险，也是知晓一些的。
藏拙，示敌以弱，让自己看起来像是个无足轻重，甚至名声狼藉的纨绔，既能摆脱掉那桩看似风光，实则不知埋着多少暗箭的婚约。
又能在家族内部降低威胁，让自己无害化，避免成为某些人眼中的靶子……好处真是多得数不过来！
而现在，韬光养晦结束，天赋和实力终于到了可以兑现，不再需要隐藏的时候，自然要选一个最合适的舞台，向所有人展现出来。
后天的誓约决斗，万众瞩目，正是最好的机会！
届时，不仅能够顺理成章地摆脱婚约，更能向帝国与家族展示那已然兑现的惊人天赋和实力，一举扭转所有坏名声，增加在家族内部竞争的筹码……
这可真真是好算计呀！
薇薇安自觉已经看透了一切，她笑嘻嘻地将这些猜测给说了出来。

最后还问了克洛伊一句：“学长，我说的对不对呀？”
克洛伊没有立刻回答。
他将目光从薇薇安那张写满“快夸我聪明”
的俏脸上移开，低头看向自己的手掌。
薇薇安猜得当然全都是错的。
真正的克洛伊是个什么德行，他一个玩过游戏的玩家再清楚不过，那就是个被压抑环境逼到心理扭曲的倒霉蛋，跟藏拙、城府这些词压根不沾边。
但是……
他自己现在也有点搞不懂了。
为什么自己能这么强？
是穿越带来的某种未知异变，潜移默化地改造了这具身体？还是昨夜那数百次惨烈死亡、用灵魂铭刻下来的战斗本能，其效果远远超出了自己的想象，甚至在一定程度上激发或者说替代了某种潜能？
无论如何，变强总归是好事。
content_en:
;;
Chloe looked up at her.
She bent down, looked at Chloe, and smiled mysteriously: "Senior, you have been hiding for so long, is it just to get rid of your engagement with Princess Shireen?"
In fact, Vivian also found it strange at first, why one person's feelings can be so different before and after. Ever since the contact last night, she felt a little strange. After all, although she had never been in contact with Chloe before, she was from the same college after all, and the other person was still a moderate celebrity.
He must have met before, and the Chloe he saw before gave him the feeling that he was absolutely two different people from the one he saw now.
Until that moment, when Chloe exploded the mirror image of the king-level mage with a shot, she woke up as if a hazy bubble had been popped.
It's not that Senior Chloe has changed too much, but that she was just hiding her clumsiness and acting!
And if you think about it carefully, it is easy to guess the purpose of the other party. Why has Chloe not done anything contrary to her infamous reputation for so long, but yesterday when the princess mentioned the oath duel to cancel the engagement, he immediately agreed?
The more I think about it, the more it feels right, and the more I feel it is right, the more I think about it.
This level of concealment may be too much and a little deliberate for other people, but for Chloe, it seems completely normal.
After all, the identity lies here.
The third son of the Grand Duke of the North was selected by the emperor as the marriage partner of the princess. How deep the water is, how many imperial power disputes are involved, and the strife within the family, just thinking about it makes people feel numb.
Vivian herself is also the daughter of an earl. Although she is not as deep as the duke or the royal family, she is still aware of these intricate interest entanglements and potential dangers.
Hiding one's clumsiness, showing one's weakness to the enemy, making oneself look like an insignificant, or even infamous, playboy. Not only can one get rid of that seemingly beautiful engagement, but in fact, there are many hidden secrets buried in it.
It can also reduce threats within the family, make oneself harmless, and avoid becoming a target in the eyes of some people... The benefits are too numerous to count!
But now, keeping a low profile is over, and the talent and strength have finally reached the point where they can be realized and no longer need to be hidden. Naturally, they have to choose the most suitable stage to show it to everyone.
The vow duel the day after tomorrow is the best opportunity for everyone to watch!
By then, not only will you be able to get rid of the engagement in a logical manner, but you will also be able to show the empire and family the amazing talent and strength that have been realized, reverse all bad reputations in one fell swoop, and increase the bargaining chips for competition within the family...
This is really a good plan!
Vivian felt that she had seen through everything, and she told these guesses with a smile.
Finally, he asked Chloe: "Senior, am I right?"
Chloe didn't answer right away.
He looked away from Vivian's face which had "Come on me for being smart" written all over it.
Her pretty face moved away and she looked down at her palms.
Of course Vivian's guesses were all wrong.
As a player who has played games, he knows very well what kind of character the real Chloe is. He is an unlucky guy who was forced into a psychological distortion by a repressed environment. The words "Zangzhuo" and "Chengfu" have nothing to do with it.
But...
He himself is a little confused now.
Why can you be so strong?
Is it some unknown mutation brought about by time travel that subtly transformed this body? Or was it the fighting instinct engraved in the soul after hundreds of tragic deaths last night? Its effect far exceeded his imagination, and it even stimulated or replaced a certain potential to a certain extent?
No matter what, getting stronger is always a good thing.
